paragraphs.text: An IntelliJ IDEA-style Git workbench for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: commit graph, branches, diffs,
annotate, staging and stash.
# IDEA Git
An IntelliJ IDEA-style Git workbench for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It adds a **Git** icon to the
sidebar and opens a full central panel rather than a small widget.
> After installing or updating the bundle, refresh the Harness page once so the browser loads the la
test Client half. The Host half activates immediately.
## What it brings from IDEA
- **Readable commit graph** — colored lanes, merge curves, ref labels, HEAD emphasis and virtualized

rows.
- **Log** — branch/remote/tag tree, multi-ref filtering, search, author/path/date filters, fi

rst-parent mode and incremental loading.
- **Commit details** — subject and body, author/committer,

parents, refs, first-parent changed files with a collapsible directory tree and per-file diff.
- **D
iff viewer** — side-by-side and unified modes, intra-line word highlighting, ignore-whitespace, file
navigation, binary/large-file handling, and **selective hunk staging** straight from the working-tr
ee and index diffs, with a fine-grained (zero-context) mode that splits nearby changes into separate

ly stageable hunks.
- **Local Changes** — staged/unstaged/conflicted/untracked groups, per-file and

per-hunk staging, discard with confirmation, commit/amend/sign-off, and commit & push.
- **File hist

ory** — rename-following history for any tracked file, with a searchable file tree.
- **Annotate (bl
ame)** — per-line authors with colors, revision input, "annotate previous revision", and commit deta

ils beside the source.
- **Stash** — create, inspect, apply, pop and drop stashes.
- **Branches and
refs** — checkout (tracking remotes), create from any commit or ref, merge, rebase onto, delete, che

rry-pick, revert and reset.
- **Compare** — "compare with current" between any ref and HEAD, with a

changed-file list and per-file range diff.
- **Tags** — create lightweight or annotated tags from an

y commit.
- **Interactive rebase** — a planner over the linear range above the newest merge: reorder

, pick, squash, fixup and drop, executed through a generated `rebase -i` todo.
- **Conflicts** — an

operation banner with continue/abort, plus per-file accept-ours/accept-theirs resolution.
- **Remote
workflow** — fetch, pull, rebase-pull, push dialog with upstream selection, and ahead/behind counts

.
- **Console** — every host command with duration and exit code.
[该节后续省略]
## AI attribution: how it works
Git has no concept of "which AI wrote this", so the plugin records it the git-native way — trailers
— and displays whatever the repository already carries.
- **Display (always on)** — every trailer is parsed from the commit and rendered as a chip. Any repo

, any tool, any key works, and existing history is visible immediately.
- **Agent commits** — a regi
stered system-prompt section asks the agent to append `Assisted-by: dsh/<its model>` when it creates
a commit. This is the common case, because agent commits go through the bash tool rather than this

panel.
- **Panel commits** — the panel stamps `Assisted-by: dsh/<provider>/<model> (session <id>)` f
rom the live agents that work in this repository, which carries the model the session actually runs
plus its session id. A trailer you wrote yourself is never duplicated, and `--amend --no-edit` is le
ft untouched. When no agent matches the repository it falls back to the documented `agentDefaultMode
l` service and labels the value `default-selection` rather than pretending to be a per-agent fact.
Both stamping paths are configurable (see below); display cannot be disabled because it only reads w
hat is already in the repository.
The agent field names (`id`, `options.model`, `options.provider`, `session.header.cwd`) were confirm
ed against a live `Agent` object in this Harness (0.2.1-rc.2) with a temporary read-only probe, and
every read is guarded so a different shape degrades to the fallback instead of throwing.
## Configuration
The bundle row accepts three fields (see `cordis.patch.yml`); all default to the values shown.
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `stampAttribution` | `true` | Append the `Assisted-by` trailer to commits this panel creates. |
|
`agentCommitHint` | `true` | Register the prompt section that asks agents to stamp their own commits

. |
| `attributionKey` | `Assisted-by` | Trailer key used when stamping. |
## Known limits
IDEA features that need an editor surface (gutter blame, jump-to-source), rebase `reword` with inlin
e message editing, drag-and-drop rebase ordering, changelists and Local History are intentionally ou
t of scope for this panel.
Two attribution caveats worth knowing: when no live agent is working in the repository the stamp fal
ls back to the *default* model selection (and says so in the value), and a commit made by the agent
in a terminal is only traceable if that agent honoured the prompt-section request.
## Safety

- Git is always invoked with an argv array, never through a shell.
- Refs, hashes, branch names and

paths are validated before use; path arguments follow `--`.
- Interactive prompts, pagers and editor

s are disabled (`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`, `GIT_PAGER=cat`, `GIT_EDITOR=:`).
- Destructive actions (di

scard, hard reset, delete branch, drop stash, checkout revision) ask for confirmation.
- The plugin
exposes one authenticated Host route; browser requests use the Harness connection trust fence.
## Layout
| File | Role |

| `index.js` | Host plugin: authenticated web route, workspace discovery, RPC dispatch |
| `git-core

.js` | Git execution, validation and parsers (plain Node ESM, unit-tested) |
| `client.js` | Browser

half: slot registration, locale, graph, diff and all views |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch th

at inserts the Host row |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
## Keyboard

- `F5` refresh
- `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` commit from the message box
- `Up/Down` move through the log; `Ent

er` opens the first changed file
- `Esc` closes a diff, menu, popover or dialog
